Fix and upgrade the domain-search/registration feature on the Nxeon platform (Next.js App Router + TS + Prisma + Tailwind). Work ONLY inside your worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-idea-domains/** (full repo copy, node_modules + .env symlinked). ALL Edit/Write use absolute paths under that dir; NEVER edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-idea-domains` for shell. Verify `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix all type errors. Do NOT `npm run build`, do NOT deploy, do NOT restart services.

BACKGROUND — a real client tried to buy `mahaskitchen.in`. The registrar (name.com, via `lib/registrar.ts`) fully supports `.in` (it's available at ~$11/yr and prices ANY tld live via a probe), but Nxeon's search only offers a hardcoded 8-tld list (`POPULAR_TLDS` in `components/marketing/tlds.ts`: .com .net .io .dev .app .xyz .co .ai) and, when the client typed `mahaskitchen.in`, it threw away the `.in`, kept the base name, and suggested only 3 alternatives (.net/.io/.dev). So a registrable, available domain was never checked or shown. Fix the whole class of problem.

REQUIREMENTS:
1. **Honor the exact TLD typed.** If the user's query is a full domain (contains a dot + a tld, e.g. `mahaskitchen.in`), check THAT EXACT domain first against name.com (it supports arbitrary tlds) and show it as the primary result — never silently drop the typed tld.
2. **Say "Taken" clearly.** If a domain is unavailable, show it explicitly labelled Taken/Unavailable (not hidden, not omitted). For a taken exact match, offer: (a) alternative extensions of the same base name that ARE available, and (b) a "Transfer it in" path (the existing /dashboard/domains/transfer flow) in case they own it.
3. **Offer MANY more extensions, not 3.** When a name is searched, check availability across a BROAD set of extensions (aim ~15–24, not 3) and list them with live prices — available ones "Register", taken ones marked Taken. Broaden the catalog: add `.in` plus a comprehensive popular set — ccTLDs (.in, .co.uk, .ca, .com.au, .de, .fr, .us, .eu, .io already, .me, .tv) and gTLDs (.shop, .store, .online, .site, .tech, .app, .dev, .xyz, .org, .info, .biz, .co). Keep `.com/.net/.org` first. Put the catalog in `components/marketing/tlds.ts` (extend `POPULAR_TLDS`) and the generator's `SUGGESTABLE_TLDS` (`lib/tools/domain-vocab.ts`); bump the `MAX_TLDS`/3-suggestion cap in `lib/tools/domain-suggest.ts` so more than 3 extensions surface.
4. **Protect the metered registrar.** name.com is a metered API — reuse the existing batching + cache + rate-limit in `lib/tools/domain-availability.ts` (one batched `checkDomains` call for the whole extension list, not N calls). Prices shown must be the registrar's real returned prices (never invented); "from" indicative prices are only for the static catalog display before a search.

EXPLORE FIRST (in your worktree): `components/marketing/DomainChecker.tsx`, `components/marketing/tools/DomainGeneratorTool.tsx`, `components/marketing/tlds.ts`, `lib/tools/domain-suggest.ts`, `lib/tools/domain-vocab.ts`, `lib/tools/domain-availability.ts`, `lib/registrar.ts` (checkDomains + exact check + pricing), `app/(marketing)/domains/page.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/tools/domain-generator/page.tsx`, `app/api/tools/domain-generator/route.ts`, `app/api/dashboard/domains/generate/route.ts`, `app/dashboard/domains/register/page.tsx`, and the signed-in dashboard "Find your perfect domain" search component (grep the /dashboard/domains area). Understand the current query→candidates→availability→UI pipeline before changing it. Reuse the Nxeon design system (dark navy/black + electric-blue/purple). Wire everything to the real registrar; no stubs on the availability path.

RETURN (final text = DATA for me, not a user message): (1) files changed, 1 line each; (2) exactly how the new flow behaves for a typed exact domain (available AND taken cases) + how many extensions now show; (3) how to test (routes + example queries incl. `mahaskitchen.in`); (4) any follow-ups/risks (e.g. registrar rate/cost of larger batches). No preamble.

## Files changed
- `components/marketing/tlds.ts` — extended `POPULAR_TLDS` to 25 extensions (com/net/org first, then broad gTLD + ccTLD set incl. `.in`, `.co.uk`, `.shop`, `.tech`, etc.) and added derived `SEARCH_TLDS` (dotless, priority-ordered) as the single source for the search fan-out.
- `app/api/domains/check/route.ts` — rewrote the exact-search endpoint: honors the typed TLD (checks it first, returns it as `exact`), fans the base name across `SEARCH_TLDS` capped at 24 (one batch), returns taken/unknown results instead of dropping them, and now uses the shared `checkAvailabilityBatched` (cache + global rate-limit) instead of a raw `checkDomains` call.
- `components/marketing/DomainChecker.tsx` — renders the `exact` result as a primary card (Register / **Taken** + "Transfer it in" / couldn't-verify) plus the broad alternatives list; consumes the new `{exact, results}` shape.
- `components/customer/DomainSearch.tsx` — same primary-result + transfer-path + statused-alternatives treatment for the signed-in dashboard "Find your perfect domain"; `DomainCheckResult` type gained `sld/tld/status/available`.
- `app/dashboard/domains/register/page.tsx` — maps the registrar `DomainCheck` into the shared `DomainCheckResult` shape for the wizard.
- `lib/tools/domain-vocab.ts` — expanded `SUGGESTABLE_TLDS` (12 → 19; added `.in`, `.me`, `.online`, `.site`, `.tech`, `.info`, `.biz`).
- `lib/tools/domain-suggest.ts` — `MAX_TLDS` 3 → 6.
- `components/marketing/tools/DomainGeneratorTool.tsx` & `components/customer/DomainIdeaGenerator.tsx` — client picker cap 3 → 6.
- `test/domain-suggest.test.ts` — updated the `readTlds` cap assertion to the new 6-TLD cap.

## New flow for a typed exact domain
- Query is treated as a full domain when it has a dot with a 1+ char label before and a 2+ char TLD after (e.g. `mahaskitchen.in`, also handles multi-label like `co.uk`).
- The exact domain is checked at name.com first and returned as `exact`, then the base name across the catalog — all in ONE batched registrar call.
- **Available exact** (`mahaskitchen.in` free): shown as the highlighted primary with the registrar's real price and a Register button, followed by "More extensions".
- **Taken exact**: shown labelled **Taken** (not hidden), with a "Transfer it in" link to `/dashboard/domains/transfer?domain=…` and a heading of available alternative extensions below.
- Extensions surfaced per search: up to 24 (the exact + ~24 catalog extensions, deduped, capped to one batch) — was effectively 4–8 before. Each carries live status: available → Register, taken → Taken, registrar-unreachable → "couldn't verify" (never shown as free; prices are only ever the registrar's returned values).

## How to test
- Signed-in dashboard: `/dashboard/domains` → the "Find your perfect domain" box. Try `mahaskitchen.in`, `mahaskitchen`, `nxeon.io`, `taken-example.com`.
- Marketing (must be signed in — the endpoint is auth-gated as metered-API protection): `/domains` hero DomainChecker, same queries.
- Register wizard live re-check: `/dashboard/domains/register?domain=mahaskitchen.in`.
- Name generator breadth: `/tools/domain-name-generator` and `/dashboard/domains/ideas` now allow selecting up to 6 extensions.
- API directly (signed-in session cookie): `GET /api/domains/check?q=mahaskitchen.in` → `{ exact, results[] }` with statuses.

## Follow-ups / risks
- **Registrar cost/volume**: each keystroke-settled search now checks up to 24 domains vs ~8 before. It's still ONE batched upstream call, protected by the per-IP limit (30/min), the shared global budget (60 batches/min), and the 10-min cache — but per-search registrar volume roughly tripled; watch name.com metering if search traffic grows.
- **Generator MAX_TLDS vs MAX_LOOKUPS**: the name generator's `buildDomains` is TLD-major and still capped at `MAX_LOOKUPS = 24`; with 12 names, only ~2 selected extensions actually get checked even though the picker now allows 6. That's pre-existing behavior (the old cap of 3 already exceeded what 12 names allowed) and I intentionally left `MAX_LOOKUPS` at 24 to keep the generator to a single batch. Raising `MAX_LOOKUPS` (multi-batch) would be needed to genuinely check all 6 selected extensions per name.
- **Auth gating**: the exact-search endpoint still requires a signed-in user, so anonymous marketing visitors get the "create an account" prompt rather than live results — unchanged by design. The public name-generator path remains open.
- Indicative `fromCents` in `POPULAR_TLDS` for the newly added TLDs are display-only placeholders; real prices always come from the registrar at search time.
